id.description: Use consultation for a first visit or when unsure. Use only the supported IDs from this schema.

requestedDate.description: Preferred date in YYYY-MM-DD. Optional for first_available.

requestedTime.description: Preferred local time in HH:MM, for example 09:30.

timePreference.description: Use one of: specific_time, morning, afternoon, evening, first_available.

limit.description: How many slots to return, usually 3.

searchDays.description: How many clinic days to search from requestedDate. Use it for first_available and for broader ranges such as next week afternoons.
